_note: Local protocols are authored by the doctor/clinic, NOT generated by AI. This schema governs their format for system consumption.
title: Local Clinical Protocol Schema
description: Structure for local clinical protocols that adapt EBM recommendations to the specific practice context (formulary, resources, patient population).

protocol_structure.title: string
protocol_structure.global_guideline_reference: string — PMID or DOI of the global guideline this adapts
protocol_structure.local_adaptation_reason: string — why adaptation is needed (formulary, cost, local epidemiology)
protocol_structure.local_resistance_note: string or null — if infectious disease
protocol_structure.referral_criteria: string — when to refer to specialist
protocol_structure.authored_by: string — doctor name or role (NOT AI)
protocol_structure.review_due: string — ISO date (max 12 months from effective_date)
protocol_structure.status: string — enum: DRAFT / ACTIVE / SUPERSEDED / RETIRED

invariants: Local protocols authored_by MUST be a named doctor or pharmacist, never 'AI'.
Every local protocol MUST reference a global guideline (global_guideline_reference).
Status MUST be ACTIVE before system uses protocol in output.
Review due MUST not exceed 12 months from effective_date.
Protocol MUST have an approval_id linking to a human approval record.
